description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade procedures for various hardware devices in an OpenWRT-based system. It defines functions for checking image validity, performing upgrades tailored to specific device models, and copying configuration files, with logic for different hardware identifiers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success; used to verify image before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device's board name, calling appropriate upgrade functions or scripts for each supported hardware.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the device based on the board name, specifically for certain ASUS and TP-Link devices.
